name: Discover and order a nearby product
description: Verifies the main shopping flow from search through server-validated checkout and order history.
expected: A confirmed order appears with a server-calculated PKR total.

name: Request a local service
description: Verifies a customer can discover and request a local professional.
expected: A pending booking activity appears in Orders.

name: Use role dashboards
description: Verifies development role access exposes the corresponding operational dashboard surfaces.
expected: The Admin control center is displayed with management and analytics sections.

name: Use grounded AI assistance
description: Verifies natural-language discovery is answered using platform catalog context.
expected: A grounded response is rendered without claiming an order or payment.

name: Reject invalid checkout
description: Verifies invalid checkout input cannot create an order.
expected: LocalHub prevents the invalid operation and explains that the cart is empty.
